newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea to seek pork, chicken for '97 quota - traders.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to seek pork, chicken for '97 quota - traders.

text.p: South Korea is expected to buy 14,620 tonnes of frozen pork and 6,500 tonnes of frozen chicken in mid-November for its 1997 Minimum Market Access import quota, traders and sources said on Friday.
"We expect the announcement by the government next week," said a source, who asked not to be named.

The source said the Livestock Products Marketing Organisation (LPMO), at the request of the government, will hold an auction 20 days after the announcement to award import rights to the public. He said the auction may be held in mid-November.
Delivery for pork and chicken would be set on April 30.
Government officials were not immediately available to comment.
Earlier this morning, South Korea's state-backed National Livestock Cooperative Federation said it would invite tenders for 2,004 tonnes of pork on Tuesday for November shipment.
